sources.title: Connected sources
sources.intro: Tomny only reads what you allow: mail headers without marking them read, public feeds, Windows notifications of the apps you pick, and for allowed sites the unread count in the tab title and the site's own notifications.
sources.none: No sources yet. Add a mail account, a feed or a site.
sources.webPassive: Updates when you open the site in the built-in browser
sources.removeConfirm: Remove this source and its saved password?

presetHint.gmail: Turn on 2-Step Verification, then create an app password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords and paste it here. IMAP must be enabled in Gmail settings.
presetHint.outlook: Use an app password from your Microsoft account security page if two-step sign-in is on. Some work accounts block IMAP.
presetHint.yahoo: Create an app password in Yahoo Account Security and paste it here.
presetHint.icloud: Create an app-specific password at account.apple.com and paste it here.
presetHint.custom: Enter the IMAP server of your provider. Only TLS connections are used.

sources.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password
sources.webHint: Pick a site you sign in to in the built-in browser. Tomny watches the unread count in its tab title and, if you allow it, the notifications the site raises; it never reads the page content.
sources.label: Name
sources.osHint: Reads notifications other Windows apps showed (Zalo, Telegram, Discord, Outlook, browsers). Pick apps, or leave all unselected to include every app except Tomny.
sources.osNone: No app notifications found yet, or this is not Windows.
sources.previewHint: Off: only sender and subject are read.
sources.youtubeHint: Paste a channel link, @handle or channel id. New uploads come from YouTube's public feed; no sign-in or API key.
sources.captureHint: When the page raises a notification (an AI answer is ready, a new message), it goes to the hub and only alerts if it is important.

rules.urgentPlaceholder: One per line, for example: deadline

catalog.title: What can be connected
catalog.intro: Works: Tomny fetches it itself. Signed-in site: works while you are signed in to the site in the built-in browser. Adapter only: planned, needs a provider integration first.

triage.title: What may interrupt you
triage.intro: Rules, your lists and what you open or dismiss decide first, on this device and at no cost. Laya helps when it is already running.
triage.interruptHint: Everything else waits in the feed.
triage.learn: Learn from what I open or dismiss
triage.learnHint: Moves a sender one level up or down; never makes anything urgent by itself.
triage.packageAppsHint: Installed apps that declare notifications.show can post; they cannot mark themselves urgent.

llm.title: Ask a model about unclear items
llm.enable: Use a model for unclear items
llm.intro: Off by default. Only items the rules cannot place are sent, in small batches, with codes, numbers, links and addresses removed. The daily limit is never exceeded.
llm.includeSnippetHint: Off: only the source, sender domain and redacted subject are sent.
